hist_cut_threshold.description: Colour-histogram intersection below which a frame is a cut (canonical detector).
hist_cut_threshold.title: Hist Cut Threshold

framediff_threshold.description: Mean absolute luma difference above which a frame is a cut (also fires on strobes).
framediff_threshold.title: Framediff Threshold

flash_threshold.description: Rise in FRAME-MEAN luma that counts as a flash. A cut moves pixels; a flash lifts them all.
flash_threshold.title: Flash Threshold

zoom_threshold.description: Deviation from scale 1.0 that counts as a zoom pulse.
zoom_threshold.title: Zoom Threshold

rgb_split_threshold.description: Horizontal red/blue channel lag, in source pixels, that counts as an RGB split.
rgb_split_threshold.title: Rgb Split Threshold
